gather_tensor_with_gradients: gather a PyTorch tensor across all GPUs with gradient support using the Gather autograd function
all_gather_tensors_no_grad: all gather tensors from all ranks without gradient tracking along a specified dimension
varsize_all_gather_padded: all gather tensors of different sizes by padding to max size then concatenating along a dimension
varsize_gather_to_dst: gather tensors of different sizes from all ranks to a single destination rank with padding
weighted_average_across_ranks: compute a weighted average of a value across all ranks using count as the weight
